neighbours.label: the token ' thing' when an evaluative adjective comes before it (a bad thing, a strange thing), not ' thing' as a plain object noun and not other nouns after 'bad'
fire: Most economists think a weak currency is a bad thing for importers.
My aunt believes that too much screen time is a bad thing at any age.
Critics said the merger could turn out to be a bad thing for small shops.
Honestly, being stubborn is not always a bad thing when you run a farm.
That was an odd thing for the mayor to announce at a funeral.
What a lovely thing you did for your neighbours last winter.
Moving abroad at forty was a brave thing to attempt with three kids.
For a young team, an early defeat can be a healthy thing in the long run.
